payload.title: Wire packs into the router task, config and log line
payload.description:
- src/papyrus_content/monitoring_stories.py run_publication: build signal inputs once, then run the interleaved queue (S1.7) of packs and single items.
- Config (validate_monitor_stories, docs/monitoring-router-config.example.json, seed_router_config.py): monitorStories.singleItem (default true), monitorStories.contextPacks {enabled (default true), signals: list from the closed set conversation|acceptance|hub|cluster|resurfaced; omitted = all that have data}. No numeric knobs.
- Log line gains packs, ideasFromPacks, packsSkippedNoNewEvidence, and per pack {signal, anchor, correctedPValue}.
- CLI: papyrus ideas monitor-stories gains --packs-only / --single-only and prints packs in --dry-run (dry run writes nothing).
- Router zip: confirm infra/monitoring/build.py --router bundles the new modules (tests/test_monitoring_router zip import test).
- infra/monitoring/papyrus-monitoring.yaml: fold into RouterIdeaPolicy the read fields the signals use (listMessagesByKindAndCreatedAt, listMessageThreadsByAnchorAndUpdatedAt, listMessagesByThreadAndCreatedAt, listReferencesByCurationStatusKeyAndUpdatedAt, listSemanticRelationsBy... used, listSemanticNodesByCorpusAndNodeKey) and createSemanticRelation for S1.5. Do NOT add a policy (router role 18/20). Update test_monitoring_stories policy test and docs/monitoring-cloud.md.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
